description: Audit-tooling map of declarable premise units (owner ruling 2026-10-18; see docs/audit/PREMISE_SCOPED_FINGERPRINT_AND_CLAUDE_AUDITOR_NOTE_2026-10-18.md). It carries no premise or interpretive weight and adds no axiom content: the axiom statements live only in the premise source. Each clause is located by its existing heading line and runs to the next heading of the same or higher level. A judgment that declares premises_used binds only the declared units plus the node's shared clauses; editing any other part of the source leaves that judgment's science fingerprint unchanged. container_heading makes every subsection of the axiom section a mapped clause, so a new axiom subsection fails closed until it is mapped. Premise nodes not listed here are whole-node units. Kept outside axiom_premise_nodes.json and the memo because hundreds of runners declare those files as AUDIT_INPUT_PATHS.
